credit: From Josh Li's masterclass deck, March 2026 · slide {slide}
how: deck_images.py extracts every embedded image (pdfimages -png) and a 2x render of every page (pdftoppm -r 144) into deck/ (gitignored), then resolves each entry below to deck/resolved/<id>.png. source 'embedded' takes the largest picture on that slide (or 'pick': its index on the slide, 0 = first); source 'page' takes the whole slide render, optionally cropped with 'crop': [left, top, width, height] as fractions of the page. 'slide_exact': false means the outline only gave a range, so check deck/contact.html and correct 'deck_slide' before publishing. 'consent': 'verify' = shows a person, a name or a private conversation: the owner confirms, then set 'confirmed': true (the voiced build refuses unconfirmed ones). 'used_on' lists the webinar slides ([SLIDE: ...] titles in script-ai.md) that show it.
